reason: Provides a VS Code-style search tab for finding keywords across workspace file names and contents, with filtering controls and links to open matching files in the sidebar editor.

summaries.zh: 在侧边栏中提供类似 VS Code 的工作区搜索，可按文件名和内容查找关键词并打开匹配文件。
summaries.en: Adds a VS Code-style sidebar search tab for finding keywords in workspace file names and contents and opening matching files.

capabilities: Searches workspace file names and contents
Supports glob exclusions, regular expressions, case toggles, and result limits
Opens matching files in a sidebar editor
Registers a sidebar tab and a loopback RPC channel
